 }

 }

 JSONB detail \"nullable\"
 }

 UUID cve_id FK

 ENUM status
 }

 UUID cve_id FK

 }

 UUID cve_id FK
 ENUM source
 VARCHAR identifier
 }

 UUID id PK
 UUID cve_id FK
 VARCHAR source_container
 TEXT vendor \"nullable\"

 }

 CVECWE {
 UUID id PK
 UUID cve_id FK
 VARCHAR cwe_id
 VARCHAR source
 }

 CVESSVCAssessment {
 UUID id PK
 UUID cve_id FK \"unique\"
 VARCHAR exploitation
 }

 CVEKEVEntry {
 UUID id PK
 UUID cve_id FK \"unique\"
 DATE date_added
 }

 CVEEPSSScore {
 UUID id PK
 UUID cve_id FK \"unique\"
 FLOAT score
 FLOAT percentile
 }

 Ticket {
 UUID id PK
 INTEGER sequence_id UK
 UUID cve_id FK \"nullable, unique\"
 ENUM status
 ENUM ignore_reason \"nullable\"
 ENUM severity_manual \"nullable\"
 ENUM priority_auto \"nullable\"
 ENUM priority_override \"nullable\"
 UUID priority_override_by_id FK \"nullable\"
 TIMESTAMPTZ priority_override_at \"nullable\"
 BOOLEAN is_confidential
 UUID assignee_id FK \"nullable\"
 UUID duplicate_of_id FK \"nullable, self-ref\"
 }

 TicketAuditEvent {
 UUID id PK
 UUID ticket_id FK
 UUID user_id FK \"nullable\"
 ENUM event_type
 TEXT old_value \"nullable\"
 TEXT new_value \"nullable\"
 TEXT comment \"nullable\"
 JSONB detail \"nullable\"
 }

 TicketAccessGrant {
 UUID ticket_id PK,FK
 UUID user_id PK,FK

 TIMESTAMPTZ granted_at
 }

 TicketReference {

 UUID ticket_id FK
 VARCHAR url
 ENUM type \"nullable\"
 VARCHAR source
 }

 TicketPackage {
 UUID id PK
 UUID ticket_id FK
 VARCHAR package_name
 TIMESTAMPTZ deleted_at \"nullable\"
 }

 TicketPackageMaintainer {
 UUID id PK
 UUID ticket_package_id FK

 TIMESTAMPTZ created_at
 }

 TicketPackageTrack {
 UUID id PK

 ENUM workflow_type

 ENUM status
 ENUM delivery_status
 TIMESTAMPTZ deleted_at \"nullable\"
 }

 TicketPackageProduct {
 UUID id PK
 UUID ticket_package_track_id FK
 UUID product_id FK
 BOOLEAN eligible
 BOOLEAN is_eligible_override

 TIMESTAMPTZ eligibility_override_at \"nullable\"
 TIMESTAMPTZ released_at \"nullable\"
 TIMESTAMPTZ deleted_at \"nullable\"
 }

 Product {
 UUID id PK
 VARCHAR name
 VARCHAR version

 DATE general_support_end_date \"nullable\"
 DATE extended_support_end_date \"nullable\"
 DATE reactive_support_end_date \"nullable\"
 TIMESTAMPTZ catalog_last_seen_at
 }

 ProductRepository {
 UUID id PK
 UUID product_id FK
 VARCHAR repo_name
 TIMESTAMPTZ catalog_last_seen_at
 }

 User {
 UUID id PK
 VARCHAR username UK
 VARCHAR email UK
 BOOLEAN active
 BOOLEAN bot
 UUID external_id UK \"nullable\"
 UUID manager_id FK \"nullable, self-ref\"

 }

 UserRole {

 UUID user_id FK
 ENUM role

 }

 RoleMapping {

 VARCHAR group_name

 }

 Session {
 UUID id PK
 UUID user_id FK
 TIMESTAMPTZ expires_at

 }

 ApiKey {
 UUID id PK
 UUID user_id FK
 VARCHAR key_hash UK
 VARCHAR prefix
 VARCHAR name

 TIMESTAMPTZ revoked_at \"nullable\"
 UUID revoked_by FK \"nullable\"
 }

 IdentityAuditEvent {
 UUID id PK
 ENUM event_type
 UUID user_id FK \"nullable\"
 UUID target_user_id FK \"nullable\"
 TEXT old_value \"nullable\"
 TEXT new_value \"nullable\"
 JSONB detail \"nullable\"
 }

 SystemSetting {
 VARCHAR key PK
 VARCHAR value
 }

 SettingAuditEvent {
 UUID id PK
 ENUM event_type
 VARCHAR setting_key FK
 TEXT old_value \"nullable\"
 TEXT new_value
 UUID user_id FK \"nullable\"
 }

 FetcherConfig {
 VARCHAR fetcher_name PK
 BOOLEAN enabled
 VARCHAR schedule_override \"nullable\"
 INTEGER run_timeout
 FLOAT request_delay
 JSONB custom_settings
 }

 FetcherRun {
 UUID id PK
 VARCHAR fetcher_name FK
 ENUM status
 ENUM triggered_by
 UUID triggered_by_user_id FK \"nullable\"
 INTEGER hard_time_limit_seconds \"nullable\"
 JSONB cursor \"nullable\"
 }

 FetcherAuditEvent {
 UUID id PK
 VARCHAR fetcher_name FK
 ENUM event_type
 UUID user_id FK \"nullable\"
 TEXT old_value \"nullable\"
 TEXT new_value \"nullable\"
 JSONB detail \"nullable\"
 }

 TrackReleaseCheckpoint {
 UUID id PK
 UUID ticket_package_track_id FK \"unique\"
 VARCHAR srcmd5
 TIMESTAMPTZ last_seen_at
 }

 IBSRequest {
 UUID id PK
 INTEGER request_number UK
 ENUM state
 INTEGER superseded_by_request_number \"nullable\"
 TIMESTAMPTZ upstream_created_at
 TIMESTAMPTZ upstream_updated_at
 }

 IBSRequestAction {
 UUID id PK
 UUID ibs_request_id FK
 ENUM action_type
 VARCHAR logical_package
 VARCHAR codestream_name
 INTEGER incident_number \"nullable\"
 }

 IBSRequestActionTrack {
 UUID id PK
 UUID ibs_request_action_id FK
 UUID ticket_package_track_id FK
 TIMESTAMPTZ created_at
 }
